features: LED DIGITAL DISPLAY FOR QUICK VIEWING: Check activity information directly on the smart ring at a glance without constantly reaching for your smartphone. The built-in LED display keeps key information conveniently visible on the ring.

DAILY ACTIVITY & STEP TRACKING: Track steps, movement, distance and daily activity trends to stay aware of your routine and fitness progress. A compact alternative to wearing a larger fitness band throughout the day.

HEART RATE & SLEEP MONITORING: Monitor heart rate trends and sleep information for everyday wellness awareness. Designed for general wellness and fitness tracking only, not for medical diagnosis or treatment.

LIGHTWEIGHT WATERPROOF DESIGN: Weighing approximately 20 grams, the compact ring is designed for work, walking, exercise, commuting and everyday wear. Its waterproof design helps suit a variety of daily environments.

RECHARGEABLE & SMARTPHONE COMPATIBLE: Rechargeable design supports convenient everyday use, while compatibility with supported smartphones enables activity records, notifications and daily fitness insights. Comes with a 3-year warranty and user manual.
